description: Someone who may not collect a child at the Check-In Station, even an Adult of the child's household. Verify Pickup refuses them and shows the volunteer what to do. Only Church Managers and Church People Editors can open a restriction, because the reason and the court order are private.

fields.description: The child that the restricted person may not collect.
fields.label: Child

fields.description: The last day of the restriction. Leave it empty when it has no end.
fields.label: Valid Until

fields.description: The person who may not collect the child, when they are in the directory. Verify Pickup refuses to release the child to them.
fields.label: Restricted Person

fields.description: The name the volunteer sees. Type it when the person is not in the directory.
fields.label: Restricted Name

fields.description: What the check-in volunteer reads at Verify Pickup, such as how to know the person and whom to call. Do not write the reason here.
fields.label: What the Volunteer Sees

fields.description: The Check-In Station never shows this section.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Attach it as a private file.
fields.label: Court Order

name: Pickup Restriction
